authorship_disclosure: This protocol is frozen after V32 Stage B exists, but it embeds no performance statistic, annual result, outcome label, or outcome-bucket count. Phase 1 is structurally unable to parse Stage-B result, future-path, or outcome artifacts.
purpose: Render and review every immutable V32 event one chart at a time using only the causal signal-minus-126 through signal-time path. Freeze all blind annotations before any separately specified Phase 2 may reveal a post-signal path or outcome.

calendar_coordinate_contract.stage_a_local_index: Stage-A signal_cal_idx is identity/history only and cannot index execution or charts.
calendar_coordinate_contract.chart_index: Use prepared_candidates.signal_cal_idx in the accepted global coordinate state; require prepared signal_cal_idx minus source_signal_cal_idx to equal 1215 for every event.
calendar_coordinate_contract.missing_slots: Retain each global calendar slot; render only current_valid and hard_valid finite positive OHLC. Never forward-fill, backfill, or substitute a current survivor.
calendar_coordinate_contract.availability: Every rendered bar must have available_at no later than the event signal decision_at.
calendar_coordinate_contract.phase1_query_ceiling: No query or parsed row may exceed the exact signal date of its event; the source query ceiling is 2020-06-30.

blind_order_contract.order: Ascending full digest, then exact event_id only as a deterministic collision tie-break, computed in memory.
blind_order_contract.blind_chart_id: B- followed by the first 20 lowercase hexadecimal characters of the full digest.
blind_order_contract.chart_number: One-based sequential number after the deterministic blind sort.
blind_order_contract.phase2_reconstruction: A future Phase-2 runner must recompute the same mapping from the same frozen candidates and salt after binding the completed Phase-1 annotation hash.

phase1_chart_contract.contact_sheet_layout: 5 by 5; at most 25 charts per page
phase1_chart_contract.cell_by_cell_review_required: Open all 72 contact sheets at original resolution, preserving every native 720 by 400 panel, and classify every occupied cell individually. Use the individual PNGs for enlargement and difficult-case review.
phase1_chart_contract.entire_canvas: The causal -126 through 0 price and turnover path uses the full 720-pixel chart width; no blank future half-panel is retained.
phase1_chart_contract.price_scale: Each individual Phase-1 chart uses its own scale computed only from valid causal OHLC in relative sessions -126 through 0.
phase1_chart_contract.turnover_scale: Each individual Phase-1 chart uses its own turnover scale computed only from causal relative sessions -126 through 0.
marks: signal-time vertical divider and signal close marker
phase1_chart_contract.visible_identity: The chart title contains only opaque chart_number and blind_chart_id. Symbol, date, industry and event_id are absent from images, filenames, contact sheets and public indexes.
phase1_chart_contract.review_template: phase1_review_template.json contains exactly chart_number, the five bound boolean labels, evidence and reviewer. It is not valid for finalization until all evidence/reviewer values are completed.
forbidden_phase1_outputs: result, return, lifecycle or outcome label
phase1_chart_contract.publication: Build in a unique same-parent staging directory, reverify all allowed bound inputs, audit exactly-once blind coverage, atomically rename, refuse overwrite, and remove only runner-owned staging on failure.

phase1_review_contract.review_order: Ascending sheet_number then slot, classifying every occupied cell; use the corresponding individual PNG whenever enlargement or ambiguity review is needed.
phase1_review_contract.freeze_before_phase2: The fully completed 1,781-row annotation ledger and every Phase-1 chart/index artifact must be hashed before any Phase-2 specification is written or any outcome-bearing artifact is opened.

phase1_annotation_freeze_tooling.finalizer_input: The public six-column blind_index.csv plus one or more annotation JSON arrays conforming exactly to the bound schema.

signal_time_taxonomy.none_clear_policy: NONE_CLEAR is not a reviewer field; the finalizer derives it only when all five frozen booleans are false.
signal_time_taxonomy.evidence: Required nonempty single-line signal-time observation, at most 240 characters.
signal_time_taxonomy.reviewer: Required nonempty reviewer identity, at most 80 characters.

future_phase2_gate.required_binding: Exact SHA-256 of the complete immutable Phase-1 annotation ledger plus this spec, renderer, blind index and chart corpus manifest.
future_phase2_gate.reserved_rendering: Only a separately authorized Phase 2 may query relative sessions +1 through +126, parse frozen Stage-B outcomes, reconstruct blind identities in memory, or render outcome attribution. Pre-signal and post-signal price/turnover scales must be independent.

future_rule_policy: Phase 1 permits morphology annotation only. Rule compression, rule-outcome aggregation and strategy replay require later independent freezes after the two-phase review is complete.
prohibited: reading or hashing Stage-B result, future_paths or outcomes during the Phase-1 run beyond comparing their already-declared path/hash strings in authorization metadata
reading any post-signal bar or any row after 2020-06-30
opening any 2021 or later row or outcome
showing symbol, signal date, industry, event_id, signal factor value, return or lifecycle state to the Phase-1 reviewer
generating full charts, post-signal charts, outcome sheets, outcome groups or outcome annotations
chronological, industry, symbol, date, signal-value or outcome-based ordering
skipping, sampling, deleting, duplicating or reselecting any of the 1,781 events
compressing visual rules, aggregating rules against outcomes, strategy replay, market-state filtering or parameter search
